---
title: "Local Setup"
description: "Environment setup, make targets, and database tooling for running Polydelve locally."
---

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.14+, [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
- Node.js 20+, npm
- Docker (for local Postgres)

<Steps>

<Step>
**Install dependencies:**

```bash
make be-install    # backend deps via uv
make fe-install    # frontend deps via npm
```
</Step>

<Step>
**Set environment variables.** Copy the secrets template and fill in keys:

```bash
cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
```

Only `DATABASE_URL` is needed to run the API and tests. Auth0 keys enable login; OpenAI, Exa and the GCP service accounts are only needed for ETL jobs. Full list: [Environment Variables](/docs/reference/env-vars).

For the frontend, copy `frontend/.env.example` to `frontend/.env.local`, or set `VITE_SKIP_AUTH=true` to skip Auth0 entirely.

For local dev the app runs against a local Postgres instance — no cloud DB token needed.
</Step>

<Step>
**Run migrations** against local Postgres (after first clone):

```bash
cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
```
</Step>

<Step>
**Start the app:**

```bash
make dev     # backend (port 8000) + frontend (port 5173) concurrently
make be      # backend only
make fe      # frontend only
```

`make dev` starts a Dockerized Postgres 16 instance automatically and stops it on Ctrl-C:

```
postgresql://polydelve:polydelve@127.0.0.1:5432/polydelve_dev
```
</Step>

</Steps>

## Useful make targets

```
make etl-news               fetch news, generate + rerank featured contracts
make build-cve-history      pull CVE data from OSV for all tracked packages
make etl-packages           refresh package metadata (downloads, risk score)
make etl-epss               update EPSS scores from the daily bulk file
make resolve-contracts      resolve open contracts (wins + expiries), credit bits
make be-test                run backend test suite
make lint                   lint backend (ruff) and frontend (lint + typecheck)
```

Run `make help` to see all targets.

## nvim-dbee

[nvim-dbee](https://github.com/kndndrj/nvim-dbee) works well for browsing the local database. Add a connection to your dbee config:

```lua
{
  name = "polydelve-local",
  type = "postgres",
  url = "postgresql://polydelve:polydelve@127.0.0.1:5432/polydelve_dev",
},
```

Then run `:Dbee` to open the UI.

<img src="https://assets.polydelve.com/dbee-local.png" alt="nvim-dbee querying the local Postgres DB" />

### Key bindings

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `<CR>` | Execute query (`n` = next page) |
| `cw` | Close window |
| `dd` | Delete note |
| `<Esc>` / `q` | Close menu |

## Connecting to RDS (prod)

When RDS is provisioned, temporarily allowlist your IP in the RDS security group (port 5432) and add a second connection to your dbee config:

```lua
{
  name = "polydelve-prod",
  type = "postgres",
  url = "postgresql://<user>:<pass>@<rds-endpoint>:5432/polydelve",
},
```

<Callout type="warn">
  Revoke the security group rule when done — never leave port 5432 open to a public IP.
</Callout>
